title: Make a project script runnable
task: Make the supplied bin/health-check runnable by its owner, then run it from the project root and save its output to status.txt.
hints: Use ls -l bin/health-check to inspect the script's permissions.
Use chmod u+x on the script to add execute permission for its owner.
Run ./bin/health-check > status.txt from the project root.

checks.label: The supplied script has owner execute permission

demo.explanation: The owner has read and write permission. There is no x in the owner's three permission slots.
u selects the owner, + adds a permission, and x lets the owner execute the file.
./ starts from your current directory. Bash sends the script's standard output to version.txt. Running the command again replaces the file contents.
